notes: The tuition was stated in USD (7,500 USD/year); the task allowed EUR or HUF, but the page states USD, so USD was used and the amount is 750000 minor units (USD). The application channel: the pages say to apply through the official online platform of the university (direct application), not through Stipendium Hungaricum for self-financed applicants. The deadline 15th June is recurring (no year stated for this programme's own page); the general application deadlines page gives 'for September 2026/2027 intake: all other programs: 15th June 2026' and 'for January/February 2026/2027 intake: all programs: 1st November 2026' but does not specify that these apply to non-EU self-financed applicants for this specific programme, so the recurring deadline was used. The institution-wide tuition page lists Mechanical Engineering at 7,500 USD/year, which matches the programme page. Document quotes for transcripts/passport/CV/medical certificate were taken from the general application page where the list is stated for all applicants.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.

note.fr: Vérifiez les dates d'examen d'entrée et les conditions d'admission (examens écrits et oraux en mathématiques et physique).
note.en: Check the entrance exam dates and admission conditions (written and oral exams in Mathematics and Physics).
